run_tic_tac_toe_training: run the tic tac toe Q-Learner script to train two agents by playing against each other for a configurable number of episodes
create_qlearner_agents: create tabular Q-Learner agents using open_spiel.tabular_qlearner.QLearner with player id and number of actions
evaluate_against_random: evaluate trained Q-Learner agents against random agents to measure win rates over a specified number of episodes
pretty_print_board: pretty print the tic tac toe board state from a time step into a human-readable 3x3 grid
play_interactive_game: play an interactive tic tac toe game against trained Q-Learner agents from the command line
